title: Chain record (SPEC section 15, row 'Chain')
description: chainId, RPC endpoint *names*, explorer URL, confirmation depth 200, start block and network identity. Secret URLs are never committed, so only the environment variable names appear here.

name.description: Stable slug for the network, used in logs and in the Verify page.

displayName.description: Human name of the network as the app says it to a player: the network guard sentence, the Switch button and the chainName handed to wallet_addEthereumChain (SPEC section 9.2). Distinct from the slug in name.

nativeSymbol.description: Symbol of the chain's native coin; BNB on chains 56 and 97.

explorerUrl.description: Public block explorer origin. Null when the network has none (a local anvil chain).

confirmationDepth.description: SPEC sections 10.3 and 15: display confirmation depth fallback is 200 blocks.

startBlock.description: Verified deployment block the indexer scans from. Null in a chain record until a deployment exists on that chain.

finalityTag.description: SPEC section 10.3: 'finalized' where supported, falling back to 'safe' and then to the 200-block depth.

networkIdentity.description: Verified genesis / network identity (SPEC section 15). Only public facts; nothing here is fetched at runtime.

multicall3.description: Canonical Multicall3 for this chain, verified in the manifest (SPEC section 10.3). Null until verified on this chain.

anyOf.description: The Chainlink Automation registry this chain publishes (SPEC section 10.3, ADR 039). Optional: a chain with no Automation deployment, or one nobody has verified yet, simply omits it. When a manifest records contracts.upkeep.registry, validator rule D28 requires it to be this address, so a wrong registry in a registration is caught here rather than by an upkeep that silently never runs.

checkGasLimit.description: Published checkGasLimit for this chain. checkUpkeep must complete under it or the registry records nothing due.

performGasLimit.description: Published performGasLimit for this chain; the ceiling for the gas limit chosen at registration.

rpcEnvVars.description: Names only. The public endpoint serves the app; the operational endpoint serves keeper and indexer and requires full log history (SPEC section 10.3).

displayName.$comment: Constrained in $defs/chainCommon; required on the chain record itself (it is what the app calls the network) but optional on the copy a manifest or plan embeds.

nativeSymbol.$comment: Constrained in $defs/chainCommon; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.

startBlock.$comment: Constrained in $defs/chainCommon; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.

networkIdentity.$comment: Constrained in $defs/chainCommon; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.
